_comment: A machine whose only purpose is to be EASY TO BUILD, so that structure formation can be
tested in a few seconds rather than by assembling an alloy furnace.
Layout, all offsets relative to the controller at (0,0,0):
The two bus positions name the interchangeable groups casings_item_input and
casings_item_output (machinery/variables/casings.var.json), so every tier of the bus,
the matching ME bus and the ME pattern provider all satisfy the same position.
y = 0      C C C            C = modularmachinery:blockcasing
C * C            * = the CONTROLLER (not listed -- it is the origin)
So: a 3x3 floor of nine casings with the controller in the middle, and three components
sitting on the three middle cells of the row behind it.
To use it: place the controller, run /modularmachinery bind test_multiblock while looking
at it, then /modularmachinery check to see what the matcher is missing.
